title: Judge allows NAACP lawsuit over xAI data center pollution to move forward
script:
A federal judge just allowed an NAACP lawsuit against xAI to move forward.
The NAACP claims the Memphis data center violates the Clean Air Act.
This facility runs on thirty-five gas turbines to power large-scale AI models.
Residents claim the site pollutes their neighborhood without proper environmental review.
The lawsuit alleges the company bypassed standard state and federal air quality permits.
The court will now determine if the site requires a federal permit.
Would you prioritize rapid AI infrastructure expansion over local air quality?
